items.title: Dak Lak police prosecute shop owner for counterfeit Gucci, LV, Hermes among 1,820 fake items
items.summary: Dak Lak provincial police economic-crime unit raided the TN Luxury store, seizing 1,820 clothing items, bags, wallets, belts, shoes and eyewear worth over VND 1.2 billion bearing signs of counterfeiting Nike, Adidas, Burberry, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Puma and Hermes trademarks. A July 20 National Institute of Intellectual Property assessment confirmed the goods as counterfeit, and the shop owner Nguyen Dinh Tuan was prosecuted; one of several similar cases opened across Vietnam in August 2026.

items.title: Phu Tho shop owner charged over 1,115 pairs of counterfeit Nike, Adidas, Gucci shoes
items.summary: Police in Phu Tho province charged Nguyen Van Chung, 35, under Article 226 (industrial property rights infringement) after seizing 1,115 pairs of counterfeit shoes bearing Adidas, Nike and Gucci trademarks plus roughly 500 fake boxes, tags and labels, valued at about VND 253 million. Part of a broader wave of IP-enforcement prosecutions hitting counterfeit sellers of Gucci and other luxury brands across multiple Vietnamese provinces this month.

items.title: Gucci previews Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection to Filipino celebrities at Greenbelt
items.summary: Gucci hosted an exclusive Manila preview of its Demna-designed Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection at Greenbelt 4 on July 31, styling seven Filipino personalities including Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee and Bella Racelis in pieces such as the updated Bamboo 1947 bag, Horsebit Duomo bag and Tag crossbody. Coverage frames the event as positioning Gucci as a shared cultural touchpoint blending the new creative direction with local celebrity style.

items.title: Indonesian investor outlet: Kering Q2 2026 improves but Gucci recovery still unconfirmed
items.summary: Indonesian investment-news outlet Pluang covered Kering's Q2 2026 results for local investors, noting group revenue returned to growth after twelve straight quarterly declines, driven mainly by a narrowing downturn at Gucci, while cautioning that weak store traffic and declining mainland China sales persist. The piece calls the outlook 'uncertain,' rates Kering shares Neutral, and says Gucci's new collections offer hope but need Q3 results to confirm a genuine turnaround.

items.title: Kering H1 2026: Asia-Pacific ex-Japan roughly flat to down 1%, Gucci Q2 organic sales down 2%
items.summary: Kering's official H1 2026 results release states Asia-Pacific (covering SEA markets) was broadly flat to down about 1% in Q2, a sequential improvement, while mainland China remained the toughest market. Gucci's Q2 organic revenue fell 2% (versus an 8% Q1 decline), beating analyst expectations of a steeper drop, aided by the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches; kept in the pool as the primary source underlying ongoing regional analyst commentary this week.

items.title: TikTok creator praises Gucci Paparazzo bag as underrated versus feed hype
items.summary: A luxury/bag-focused TikTok creator posted a review of the Gucci Paparazzo large top-handle bag under #gucci #designerbag #luxurytiktok #bagtok, saying she had not seen the bag anywhere on her feed and that it looks even better in person. Representative of grassroots product-level SNS chatter around Gucci's newer leather-goods launches (Borsetto/Paparazzo) that Kering cited as driving Q2 improvement; exact post date not shown on page, engagement counts not visible in page view.

items.title: VnExpress reader-opinion column: buying a cheap fake Gucci bag still abets fraud
items.summary: A Vietnamese reader-opinion piece on VnExpress International argues that Vietnamese consumers who buy counterfeit Gucci or other luxury-branded bags for a few dollars 'just for fun' are still nurturing an entire illegal manufacturing and distribution ecosystem, pushing back on the common justification that small counterfeit purchases are harmless. Read alongside this week's wave of counterfeit-seller prosecutions, it captures a strand of Vietnamese public sentiment critical of the counterfeit-Gucci economy rather than the brand itself.
